productLaunches.title: Onepin
productLaunches.description: AI voiceover with every name, price and date said right - AI voices sound human now. But they still guess names from the spelling, and nobody has time to listen to every line. Onepin runs on the voices you already use (ElevenLabs, OpenAI, Google, 30+ more), spells out prices and dates, checks names against a 4M-word pronunciation dictionary, scores every line, and fixes the wrong word without re-rendering the take. Built for teams shipping AI voiceover in several languages: product videos, dubbing, courses. Free to start, no credit card required.

productLaunches.title: ReSO AI
productLaunches.description: Get discovered & recommended when customers ask AI - ReSO is a generative engine optimization platform that helps brands show up in AI search results. It’s built for founders, CMOs, and growth teams who want to turn buyer intent in ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AIO into visibility, citations, and traffic. What makes it different is that it doesn’t just track rankings, it analyzes intent, competitors, content gaps, and technical issues, then turns them into priority actions to improve AI recommendations.

productLaunches.title: Claude Dashboards & Motion
productLaunches.description: Ask Claude for live dashboards and animated explainers - Claude Dashboards and Claude Motion are beta artifacts in Claude. Dashboards connects to BigQuery, Databricks, Snowflake, Redshift, ClickHouse or Salesforce and turns a plain language question into a live dashboard that refreshes as your data changes, with the query behind every number. Motion turns reports, charts and walkthroughs into short animations written as code, so you can edit any word, number or timing, then export an MP4. Dashboards is on paid plans, Motion on Team and Enterprise.

productLaunches.title: Skreno
productLaunches.description: Record, edit and share videos, all in your browser - Skreno is a video studio in your browser: record, edit and share in one place. Record your screen and camera as separate tracks, then edit in Studio: pick a layout, cut silences, and add animated captions and titles. Share one link with a transcript, AI summary and comments on the exact second. Send a request link and anyone can record for you, no account needed. Bug reports come with the console log attached.

productLaunches.title: Cue
productLaunches.description: Put your AirPods in, your Mac starts focusing - Your headphones become a focus switch. Put your AirPods in and your Mac turns on your Focus mode, blocks distracting sites and starts a timer in the notch. Take them out: break time, sites come back. Also in the notch: now playing, volume and brightness, your own colors, session history and two tiny buddies that react to everything. Free, private, macOS 14+ on Apple Silicon. Vibe-coded by one person and Claude.

items.title: Arena 完成 2 亿美元 B 轮融资，估值 31 亿美元并发布 Alignment Index
items.summary: Arena 完成 2 亿美元 B 轮融资，估值 31 亿美元，由 Lightspeed 和 Khosla Ventures 联合领投，a16z、Felicis、Salesforce Ventures、The House Fund 等参投。自 A 轮以来，Arena 年化收入超 1 亿美元，平台累计 3.5 亿场次会话，约 5 个月内产生 700 万次 Agent Arena 会话，覆盖文本、视觉、代码、搜索、图像和视频的投票达 6200 万，用户遍布 150 多个国家。融资同时，Arena 发布基于真实智能体轨迹构建的 Alignment Index，对 20 多个前沿模型从 Unauthorized Action、False Attribution 和 Deceptive Completion 三个信号进行评估。Arena 于 2023 年作为 UC Berkeley 研究项目启动，2025 年成为公司。

items.title: ReSO AI
items.description: Get discovered & recommended when customers ask AI - ReSO is a generative engine optimization platform that helps brands show up in AI search results. It’s built for founders, CMOs, and growth teams who want to turn buyer intent in ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AIO into visibility, citations, and traffic. What makes it different is that it doesn’t just track rankings, it analyzes intent, competitors, content gaps, and technical issues, then turns them into priority actions to improve AI recommendations.

items.title: Microsoft-Decision-1
items.description: Microsoft’s decision model for agents and workflows - Microsoft-Decision-1 is a decision-scoring model for routing, classification, verification and agent control. Give it fixed options and it returns a calibrated probability for each in a single pass, as structured output software can act on directly. Post-trained from Qwen3.5-9B, it is about 35x faster than GPT-6 Sol at median latency, per Microsoft. Available now in Microsoft Foundry at $0.042 per million input tokens, with free output.

items.title: Lune
items.description: The search engine built for scientific AI agents - Lune is Exa.ai for scientific research. It connects AI agents to research knowledge and tools built for scientific workflows, and provides high-quality knowledge grounding based on papers from top-tier academic conferences. 10x the efficiency and trustworthiness of literature review, experimental design, writing and peer review. From early ideas to publication, it helps researchers and technical teams move faster with traceable sources, deeper grounding, and rigorous, evidence-backed decisions.

items.title: Isly
items.description: Your MacBook notch, brought to life. - Isly turns the MacBook notch into a living control center: music from any app with cover art and scrubber, live timers and calendar events, clean volume/brightness readouts, and more - all without leaving your workflow. Light on resources (≈0.2% CPU idle, ~49 MB RAM), smooth animations, and a one-time €3.99 license with free updates. For macOS 14+ with a notch.
